sloka: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान् ।वानरान् वारणेन्द्राभान् क्षिप्र द्रक्ष्यसि सङ्गतान् ।। ५.३९.४९।।।।
transliteration: nakhadaṁṣṭrāyudhān vīrān siṁhaśārdūlavikramān ।vānarān vāraṇendrābhān kṣipra drakṣyasi saṅgatān ।। 5.39.49।।।।

translations.english: "You will soon see heroic vanaras whose weapons are their teeth, who are like lion and tiger in their valour. They are (mighty) like wellbred elephants.
